title: Remove Z-Axis Gearbox for OptiSweep Z-Axis Gearbox Replacement (A-axis jog + LOTO + side panel removal)
summary: Prepare the OptiSweep Z-axis for gearbox replacement by manually positioning the A-axis/counter-balance to the specified threaded-hole location using the tipper HMI, performing tipper lockout/tagout (LOTO), removing the station side panel (nine self-tapping fasteners), and exposing the motor/gearbox area. Install an M6 socket-head screw below both carriages to prevent dropping once belt tension is released.
when_to_use: Use when preparing an OptiSweep Z-axis gearbox replacement and you must (1) position the A-axis/counter-balance between the actuator-base threaded holes, (2) lockout/tagout the tipper, and (3) remove the station side panel to access the motor/gearbox area.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a complete gearbox replacement workflow (it only covers the removal preparation steps evidenced in the provided manual section/page excerpt).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the A-axis/counter-balance jog on the tipper HMI, execute tipper LOTO using the referenced Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure, remove the nine side-panel fasteners, remove the station side panel, and install the M6 socket-head screw below both carriages.
safety_notes: Perform tipper LOTO using the manual’s referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure (page 2).
Stop if the A-axis/counter-balance cannot be positioned as described or cannot be held in place with the M6 socket-head screw.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to tipper station for LOTO and side panel removal

access_required: Physical access to the tipper station
system_preconditions: Tipper is capable of manual jog positioning of the A-axis and counter-balance via the tipper HMI.
external_references: Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure on page 2 (referenced by the manual for tipper LOTO).

visual_references.description: Figure 7-7: Gearbox diagram supporting the removal preparation steps (A-axis/counter-balance positioning, tipper LOTO reference, nine side-panel fasteners, and M6 socket-head screw below both carriages).

steps.title: Jog A-axis and counter-balance to the threaded-hole position
steps.purpose: Position the A-axis/counter-balance so the gearbox removal preparation can proceed safely and so the carriages can be secured to prevent dropping after belt tension is released.
steps.instruction: On the tipper HMI (WebVisu/VISU), manually position (jog) the A-axis and counter-balance between the threaded holes in the actuator base. There are two holes adjacent to each rail; position the carriages between the holes on the respective rails.
steps.expected_result: A-axis/counter-balance are positioned between the threaded holes with carriages between the holes on their respective rails.
steps.healthy_condition: Carriages are visibly located between the two threaded holes adjacent to each rail (as shown in the gearbox figure).
steps.failure_condition: A-axis/counter-balance cannot be positioned between the threaded holes as described, or carriages cannot be placed between the holes on their respective rails.

actions.label: Manual jog A-axis/counter-balance
actions.exact_action: Use the HMI to manually position (jog) the A-axis and counter-balance between the threaded holes in the actuator base.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the A-axis/counter-balance cannot be positioned between the threaded holes as described.

steps.title: Perform tipper LOTO using the referenced Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is locked out/tagged out before removing the station side panel and accessing the motor/gearbox area.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO for the tipper using the manual’s referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure (page 2).
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is completed for the tipper per the referenced Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure (page 2).
steps.failure_condition: LOTO cannot be completed safely using the referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure.

actions.label: Execute tipper lockout/tagout
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if LOTO cannot be completed safely using the referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure.

steps.title: Remove the station side panel fasteners and the station side panel
steps.purpose: Expose the motor/gearbox access area by removing the station side panel secured with nine self-tapping fasteners.
steps.instruction: Using a 3/8-in. wrench or socket, remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed and the motor/gearbox access area is exposed.
steps.healthy_condition: All nine self-tapping fasteners are removed and the station side panel is removed without remaining fasteners attached.
steps.failure_condition: Fasteners cannot be removed with the 3/8-in. wrench/socket, or the side panel cannot be removed to access the motor.

actions.label: Remove side panel fasteners
actions.exact_action: Use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

steps.title: Install M6 socket-head screw below both carriages to prevent dropping
steps.purpose: Prevent the A-axis and counter-balance from dropping once belt tension is released during subsequent gearbox removal steps.
steps.instruction: Insert an M6 socket-head screw into the holes below both carriages. These fasteners prevent the A-axis and counter-balance from dropping once belt tension is released.
steps.expected_result: An M6 socket-head screw is installed into the holes below both carriages.
steps.healthy_condition: M6 socket-head screw(s) are seated in the holes below both carriages, providing mechanical retention as described.
steps.failure_condition: M6 socket-head screw cannot be inserted into the holes below both carriages, or the carriages cannot be held in place.

actions.label: Insert M6 screw below carriages
actions.exact_action: Insert an M6 socket-head screw into the holes below both carriages.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the carriages cannot be held in place with the M6 socket-head screw.

success_criteria: A-axis/counter-balance are positioned between the threaded holes with carriages between the holes on their respective rails.
Tipper is locked out/tagged out using the referenced Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure (page 2).
Station side panel is removed and the motor/gearbox access area is exposed.
M6 socket-head screw is installed below both carriages to prevent dropping once belt tension is released.
healthy_conditions: Carriages are between the two threaded holes adjacent to each rail.
LOTO is completed for the tipper per the referenced procedure (page 2).
Side panel removal exposes the motor/gearbox access area.
M6 socket-head screw is installed below both carriages.
failure_conditions: A-axis/counter-balance cannot be positioned between the threaded holes as described.
LOTO cannot be completed safely using the referenced Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure (page 2).
Side panel cannot be removed to access the motor.
Carriages cannot be held in place with the M6 socket-head screw.
escalation_guidance: If any stop condition is met (positioning, LOTO, side panel removal, or M6 screw retention), stop work and escalate per site maintenance escalation process (not specified in the provided packet).
